requirements.description: The user requires energy class D or better, so the filter includes every class from D up to A1-A4 (A1, A2, A3, A4, B, C, D).

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with >= 360. The capacity of 18 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified regulatory gross-area threshold was supplied. Energy class, proximity to healthcare services, and the Turin location are outside the reference columns (Turin is handled by the Location Agent).
